status: frozen before the full five-fold, three-seed run
purpose: Modern E(3)-equivariant common-cohort comparator requested during peer review

readouts.dipole_moment: norm of an equivariant center-of-mass-centered latent-charge vector

training.target_scaling: mean and standard deviation fitted on the training partition only
training.checkpoint_rule: lowest validation normalized mean absolute error
training.test_use: test targets are not used for checkpoint selection or model configuration

cohort.fold_policy: identical frozen canonical attributed graphs remain in one outer fold

metrics: direction concordance with predicted ties scored as one half

comparison_guardrail: ViSNet and SchNet receive optimized Cartesian coordinates and therefore are unequal-information common-cohort comparators, not equal-input ablations against 2D graph or CoordRep-field models.

preflight.scope: implementation and resource stability only; no smoke-test performance value was used to select the production configuration
preflight.float16_status: rejected before production because the one-epoch stability test produced non-finite training values
preflight.bfloat16_status: accepted because the same one-epoch full-fold stability test completed with finite training, validation, and prediction values
